# Harmon Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** male (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P22](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Personality

Harmon Andrews is a figure who advocates for strict discipline. He notably believes that physical punishment, such as using the strap, should be employed more frequently.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_

## History

During a gathering of town mothers after the school year ends, Harmon Andrews is mentioned as the mothers discuss Anne's upcoming departure for college. The group also talks about the impending loss of Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and reflects on young [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's unique imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV.
